project_info.title: Development and Validation of a Thermo-Mechanical Model for Fire-Resistant Structural Elements Utilizing High-Performance Rubberized Concrete
project_info.description: Synthetic dataset for high-performance concrete system incorporating crumb rubber (CR) content and particle size variations

data_quality.realism: All data points fall within scientifically accepted ranges for concrete technology
data_quality.consistency: Data for each mix ID is self-consistent with proper material balance
data_quality.variation: Controlled random noise (±5-10%) added to simulate experimental error
data_quality.completeness: Exhaustive dataset including all necessary parameters for analysis
data_quality.traceability: Full batch tracking and specimen identification system

file_structure.constituent_materials_crumb_rubber.csv: Crumb rubber properties for two particle sizes
file_structure.mix_proportions_fresh_properties.csv: Core operational dataset with mix proportions and fresh properties
file_structure.thermal_properties.csv: Thermal properties and fire resistance data
